verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents ways to interrupt and redirect a running agent. The terminal CLI lets you pause the agent with Esc and resume previous conversations. Agent Canvas is described as a browser control center for agent conversations, and goal-driven UIs can offer stop/resume controls. There is no evidence of taking over the work itself in an editor, or of handing the agent's live workspace to the developer to finish manually. missing for 10: editor/IDE takeover, explicit hand-off of the agent's in-progress workspace for manual completion, hands-on corroboration of redirecting mid-task.

support.subject: As a developer, I can take over an in-progress agent task in my editor, terminal, or browser to finish or redirect the work

citations.quote: Agent Canvas is the open-source browser client and control center for agent conversations and automations.
the UI can show progress with stop/resume controls
